Caption / description / post text:
Mac and Cheese is an absolute must on Thanksgiving, here’s how I make mine 🤤 Next video I’ll show you how to make some bangin cornbread stuffing as well  Ingredients: 1/3 cup Butter (5 1/2 ish tbsp)  1/3 cup flour  ~ 3-4 cups whole milk (adjust for your desired thickness)  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tbsp smoked paprika  1/2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1/2 tsp ground ginger  1/2 cup heavy cream 2 tbsp Dijon mustard  Salt and pepper to taste  2 slices American Cheese  2 cups Mild-Medium Cheddar  1 cup Gruyère Cheese  1 cup Gouda  2 cups Mozzarella Cheese 2 pounds your pasta of choice  Chives to garnish  #macandcheese #cheese #thanksgiving #cheesy #recipe 

Transcript of the video's audio (machine-made):
Let me show you guys how I like to make my mac and cheese for Thanksgiving. Now naturally this recipe starts with cheese and my go-to combo has always been cheddar, gouda, gruyere, and mozzarella. Now over at the stove we're gonna go ahead and start melting our butter and into that melted butter we're gonna start blooming our spices. Once your house is smelling beautiful we're gonna add in the equal amount of flour as we did butter. Let that flour cook down for a couple minutes and it's time to start slowly adding in our milk. At first it's gonna look like this and you might think you ruined Thanksgiving but just keep adding milk and I promise you'll be met with a smooth bechamel in no time. And the cheese is gonna thicken this a lot so you do want to make this a little bit thinner than you think you need to. We're gonna finish this off with a nice spoonful of Dijon mustard and to make it extra luxurious a nice splash of heavy cream. Now before we add any cheese go ahead and start cooking up your pasta of choice. Now if you've ever had a grainy mac and cheese it's because your sauce got too hot and the cheese split so before we do anything else it's time to turn off the heat. And that carry-over heat will be more than enough to start melting our cheese starting with just two slices of American. I promise you won't even taste this it is just for the emulsifiers. Next in small batches we can start adding that cheese blend and you cannot tell me that that right there is not as luxurious and beautiful as you. And we haven't added any salt yet so generously season the taste and our cheese sauce is done. By now our pasta should be done and is ready to go into the sauce. Get that mac and cheese poured up into an oven safe dish. Top that off with another light layer of our cheese blend and after a couple minutes under the broiler we are left with this absolute beauty. Garnish it up with you guessed it even more chives and just like that our mac and cheese is ready to join our Thanksgiving feast.
